content.text: The internet has brought unprecedented opportunities for digital creators to reach global audiences and monetize their skills and knowledge. Yet, creators in many regions are locked out of this opportunity by the very payment platforms that enable it. Take Nigeria, for instance, where creators cannot access [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-8|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] or PayPal, two of the most popular payment processors for online courses. This exclusion is not an isolated incident; it's a systemic issue that affects creators in numerous countries, including Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines. This blog post is about a permanent solution to this problem: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-5|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments|infrastructure]].

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a set of free and open-source tools that enable creators to sell their digital products without relying on centralized platforms like Teachable or Gumroad. It's about owning your infrastructure, not renting it. Instead of paying monthly fees to platforms that may not support your region, you invest in a one-time setup that gives you complete control and ownership. This infrastructure includes hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, order storage on Supabase or Google Sheets, file delivery on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and automatic crypto payment verification through NOWPayments.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is designed to be simple, robust, and secure. When a customer purchases a product, the payment is verified on-chain by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a low 0.5% fee. Once the payment is confirmed, NOWPayments fires a webhook that triggers the backend logic. This logic could be a Cloudflare Worker or a Google Apps Script function, which handles tasks like updating the order status, sending delivery emails, and generating access links. The actual product files are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and the customer is given a direct link to download their purchase. The entire process is automated and secure, with no manual intervention required.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for creators in regions where popular payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. It's for creators who want full control over their online store and customer data, without the risk of being shut down or locked out. By using sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can bypass the limitations imposed by centralized platforms and reach a global audience directly. They can sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and any other digital product, without the need for a middleman. It's a solution that empowers creators to take control of their digital destiny, ensuring that their business is not at the mercy of payment platforms or regional restrictions.
COREMERCH stacks are deployed in 48 hours, giving you a fast track to selling online.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The beauty of sovereign commerce infrastructure is in its modularity and flexibility. Each component is chosen for its reliability, scalability, and cost-effectiveness. For hosting, GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages offer free, secure, and globally distributed hosting. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script provide powerful backend logic capabilities, allowing for complex business logic without the need for a traditional server. Supabase and Google Sheets serve as robust order storage solutions, ensuring that your sales data is secure and accessible. Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 handle file delivery, providing fast and reliable access to your digital products. And NOWPayments ties it all together, offering a simple, secure, and affordable way to accept cryptocurrency payments, with automatic verification and instant delivery.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying sovereign commerce infrastructure is straightforward with the right tools and guidance. COREMERCH offers pre-built stacks that can be deployed in 48 hours, such as the Edge Commerce Stack. This stack includes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. It also comes with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, ensuring your store is secure and functional. After deployment, COREMERCH provides 30-day support to help you get started. The goal is to empower you to own your infrastructure, not just rent it. With COREMERCH's stacks, you can focus on creating and selling your digital products, knowing that your online store is built on solid, sovereign foundations.

The Edge Commerce Stack is the flagship offering from COREMERCH, designed for creators who want a fully-featured, production-ready online store. This stack includes everything you need to sell digital products, from hosting and backend logic to order storage, file delivery, and crypto payment processing. The Edge Commerce Stack is particularly well-suited for creators who want to scale their business, offering advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability and end-to-end testing for reliability. It's a complete solution, deployed in 48 hours, that gives you the power and control of sovereign commerce infrastructure.
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON.

The Edge Commerce Stack is more than just a product; it's a pathway to financial independence for digital creators. It's a way for creators to reclaim control over their digital destiny, free from the restrictions of centralized platforms. With the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can focus on what they do best—creating and selling their digital products—without the worry of payment processing limitations or platform restrictions. It's a solution built for creators, by creators, with a deep understanding of the challenges and opportunities in the digital creator economy.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploying the Edge Commerce Stack is a straightforward process with COREMERCH's support. Here's a checklist to guide you through the process: 1. Choose your hosting platform: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. 2. Set up your backend logic: Configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing and delivery. 3. Connect your order storage: Integrate Supabase or Google Sheets to store and manage customer orders. 4. Configure NOWPayments: Set up your crypto payment gateway to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. 5. Upload your products: Add your digital products to your chosen file storage platform, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Test and deploy: Thoroughly test your store and, once satisfied, deploy it to your chosen hosting platform. 7. Promote and sell: Market your digital products and start selling, knowing your store is built on sovereign infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Why can't I just use Teachable or Gumroad?

While platforms like Teachable and Gumroad offer convenience, they also come with limitations, especially for creators in certain regions. These platforms may not support your country, or they may charge high fees for international transactions. Moreover, using these platforms means you don't own your customer data or the infrastructure. With sovereign commerce infrastructure, you have complete control and ownership, ensuring long-term stability and freedom.
Isn't accepting crypto payments risky?

Accepting crypto payments through NOWPayments is actually very secure. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain, ensuring that the transaction is valid and cannot be reversed. This is a much more secure method than traditional payment gateways, which can be subject to chargebacks and fraud. Additionally, NOWPayments supports a wide range of cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a global audience.
What if I need more products or support after 30 days?

COREMERCH offers additional products and support packages to cater to your growing business needs. You can purchase more product slots, extend support periods, or even upgrade to a higher stack. The goal is to provide a scalable solution that grows with your business, ensuring that your online store remains robust and efficient as your customer base expands.
How can I trust that my data is secure?

Security is a top priority in sovereign commerce infrastructure. All data is stored securely on your chosen platforms, such as Supabase or Google Sheets for orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for product files. These platforms offer robust security features, including encryption and access controls. Additionally, the backend logic is designed to ensure data integrity and security, with measures like webhook verification and rate limiting.
Can I customize the design and functionality of my store?

Absolutely. While the stacks provide a solid foundation, you have the flexibility to customize your store to match your brand and unique requirements. You can modify the frontend design, add custom pages, and extend the backend logic to include additional features. The stacks are designed to be extensible, allowing you to build upon them and create a truly unique digital storefront.
With sovereign commerce infrastructure, you own your data and your destiny.
